create.name: Tapas Yoga HK
create.bio:
Tapas Yoga HK (一念瑜伽) is a small yoga school in Hong Kong's New Territories, with a main studio in Yuen Long and a second room in Tsuen Wan. It was started in 2019 by Tung, a former software engineer who trained as a teacher in Mysore and now holds authorisation from the Sharath Yoga Centre to teach Ashtanga. The name draws on tapas, the inner fire of discipline in Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, while the Chinese name points to bringing the mind back to the present moment.

Both studios hold Ashtanga in the Mysore style, where each student moves through the sequence at their own pace and the teacher works with them one by one, alongside a timetable of hatha, vinyasa, yin and gentle classes in small groups, taught in Cantonese and English. The school also trains teachers: a Yoga Alliance registered 200-hour course run over weekends at Tsuen Wan, covering asana across several styles, philosophy including the Yoga Sutras, pranayama, meditation and teaching practice, and a shorter certificate course in leading singing-bowl sound sessions. Workshops on the Ashtanga primary series are held from time to time.

courses.title: 200-Hour RYT200 Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A Yoga Alliance registered 200-hour training held on weekends at the Tsuen Wan studio, in cohorts of six to ten. Trainees study hatha, vinyasa, Ashtanga and yin asana, the Yoga Sutras and yogic ethics, pranayama and meditation, and practise teaching with feedback.

courses.title: Ashtanga Yoga Mysore classes
courses.description: Two-hour Mysore-style sessions held at both studios: students work through the Ashtanga series in their own rhythm while the teacher helps each of them in turn. Suitable for newcomers and long-time practitioners; a trial class is offered.
courses.price: Trial class $200 (as published); regular rates: Contact for pricing

courses.title: 16-Hour Sound Healing Certificate Course
courses.description: A two-weekend certificate course at the Yuen Long studio for groups of six to eight. It teaches singing-bowl technique, layering tones and planning sound sessions for one person or a group, with supervised practice.
